nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set directly with the separate `Int (Width)` and `Int (Height)` nodes.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the Nine Springs environment from <Picture 1>: a continuous, level expanse of dry, matte dark stone beneath densely layered midnight-navy storm clouds, distant blue-black mountains and low mist, with deep crimson spider lilies at the margins. Far to the right of the protagonists lies the broad, dormant circular ritual site, surrounded by tiny, still, white-robed ghost figures. <Picture 1> supplies the geography, distant site, and deep-blue color palette; its panoramic camera position is not the opening frame.
<Subject 2> is Wu Wei. His face, silver hair, forehead marking, and identity come from <Picture 2>; his full-length layered dark-purple robes, purple-black feathered shoulders, and footwear come from <Picture 3>. He is already standing on the stone at his established position opposite the two women before this video begins.
<Subject 3> is the soulless double of Gui, on the LEFT in the continuation guide frames. Her dark-red, tall ceremonial headdress and facial identity are reinforced by <Picture 5>; her blue-and-gold clothing, complete physical body, and existing hovering position follow the continuation guide frames. She has no soul and gives no intentional response or directed gaze.
<Subject 4> is the original Gui, on the RIGHT in the continuation guide frames. Her face, circular gold crown, dark-blue and ivory ceremonial robes, and identity come from <Picture 4> and the continuation guide frames. She remains visibly suspended above the stone.

summary:
[video continuation + reference generation] This 10-second bridge continues directly from the previous video's ending guide frames. <Subject 3> and <Subject 4> remain in their original left-right positions, both hovering. Camera viewpoint changes bring the already stationary <Subject 2> into view opposite them, then establish the distant, inactive ritual site within <Subject 1>. <Subject 2> and <Subject 4> end by looking toward that site; <Subject 3> does not. The scene leads into a separate subsequent video of the ghosts performing the ritual.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): partially_preserved - retain the same continuous flat stone geography, crimson spider lilies, distant mountains, white-robed ghost perimeter, and dense midnight-blue storm palette from <Picture 1>, while changing the camera distance and viewpoint to follow the protagonists.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - retain Wu Wei's face, silver hair, forehead marking, purple feathered shoulders, and full-length clothing from <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>; his pre-existing position remains fixed.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - retain the left-side double's distinct dark-red tall headdress, blue-and-gold clothing, physical completeness, clear hovering gap above the stone, and vacant, unresponsive expression.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - retain the right-side original Gui's circular gold crown, dark-blue and ivory robes, identity, clear hovering gap above the stone, and restrained awareness.

detailed_description:
The target video preserves the previous shot's character identities and physical continuity. Its dark, richly saturated blue lighting develops toward the storm-cloud palette of <Subject 1> as the camera turns toward the distant landscape. Stone remains dry and matte. All three principal characters keep their established world positions throughout; only the camera viewpoint changes.

[Shot 1] Continue directly from the ending guide frames. A medium-wide frontal view holds <Subject 3> on the left, recognizable by her tall dark-red headdress, and <Subject 4> on the right, recognizable by her circular gold crown and ivory-trimmed blue robes. Both women's feet and hems remain visibly separated from the stone, at approximately their established hovering heights. Their positions and spacing match the preceding video. A gentle lateral camera slide begins immediately at slow speed. Wind barely moves their hair, veils, and sleeves. <Subject 4> carries the quiet weight of a possible final separation; her breathing and eyes change only subtly. <Subject 3> stays physically present but emotionally vacant, with an unfocused gaze. <Subject 2> is already standing opposite them at a separate fixed position outside this opening camera view.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the camera cuts to a viewpoint slightly behind and to the left of <Subject 2>'s pre-existing position. He is grounded on the same level stone, in the left foreground, facing the two hovering women across the original open space. This new viewpoint includes him without any arrival or change in his position. His silver hair, forehead marking, layered dark-purple robes, and feathered shoulders match <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>. The camera tracks slowly left and backward with a modest rise; real parallax separates him from the two women and the distant mountains. <Subject 3> remains left of <Subject 4> in the women's pair, and both still hover with visible air beneath their feet. <Subject 2> holds his grief within a small breath and a slight tightening around the eyes. Cloud cover deepens the frame from the opening's inherited gray-blue light toward the dense midnight-navy blue of <Subject 1>, without washing out the women's faces.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the camera cuts wider along the same side of the established space and continues moving slowly left and backward while rising slightly. <Subject 2> occupies the left side of the composition; <Subject 3> remains farther across the stone at center-left; <Subject 4> remains center-right. The dormant ritual site from <Subject 1> is already visible in the far RIGHT background from the beginning of this shot. As the camera eases wider and angles gently right, the broad empty circle and its tiny perimeter of white-robed ghosts become increasingly legible across several seconds, while hundreds of meters of open stone continue to separate them from the three protagonists. The navy cloud canopy, cold blue stone, low mist, and crimson flowers retain the color density of <Picture 1>. Around 00:08.000, <Subject 4> subtly directs her eyes and head toward the distant site; <Subject 2> follows her line of sight with a small, contained turn. <Subject 3> remains still, looking nowhere in particular. The moving camera gradually slows through the final moment, holding all three characters and the distant site in a coherent wide composition ready for the next video's cut. The site stays inactive: no casting, glowing circle, light columns, or energy effects begin in this video.

overall_soundscape:
Low wind moves across the stone and softly stirs fabric and spider lilies. Faint, indistinct distant crowd ambience remains far behind the protagonists. There is no dialogue, vocal filler, chanting, or synchronized music.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
